notes.title: 12.09.2025 Update - Cosmetics!
notes.content: [p]Greetings players![/p][p]It's been a hot minute since our last update but this time we've come with a brand new feature, [b]cosmetics[/b]! Now it shows the amount of people online in the server.[/p][/*][*][p]Added some potential minor performance improvements.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Balance changes[/h2][list][*][p]The Void Reaper has been reworked![/p][list][*][p]Its explosion now deals area damage just like any explosion![/p][/*][*][p]The range of its shots varies depending on the placement of your crosshair, with the maximum range being the same as the other weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased damage from 620-670 to 800-900.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased ammo from 15 to 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased shot interval from 0.4s to 0.6s.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated skill requirements from 12 Accuracy, 12 Strength, and 12 Explosions to 12 Accuracy, 4 Strength, and 10 Explosions.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated cost from 20,000 coins and 30 cash to 17,500 coins and 25 cash.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]QoL improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Added option to restart your connection to the game if you're not able to login after a black screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Steam shortcut issue that kept it auto-creating upon updating the game rather than only on install.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed level-up coins not being rewarded if leveled-up through a challenge reward.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some bullets/explosions not being rendered when many of them are on-screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bullet collision issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual bugs with the Railgun.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed chat width problems leading to text getting cut off.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with EXP requirements after the recent balance update.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue regarding the level-up popup.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We recommend making sure the page zoom setting is at 100% (in your browser) and use the page's zoom buttons to adjust it for the best experience.[/p][p][/p][p]We also want to hear which name colors would you like to see in the future! tags.feature: Added a new medal!
Patriot: Awarded for completing [b]10[/b]/[b]50[/b]/[b]100[/b] challenges.
Added background to the game page.
Scaled down the size of the game to be more like it was before.
Added buttons to change the zoom level. Zoom level can also be changed with CTRL + mouse wheel scroll.
Strength now (slightly) affects the damage output of all weapons. The more strength you have, the more damage the weapons will deal!
Updated collisions for all maps.
This includes several fixes and some surfaces which allowed bullets to go through will no longer allow it.
Single Player mode has been updated:
Bots now have different behaviors which determine their playstyle:
Aggressive: They will actively go to your position and will shoot slightly faster than normal.
Tactical: They can crawl and crouch.
Defensive: They will run away from you if you get close to them.
Bots now have the same range as the player (before they had slightly less range than them).
Added a 2-second spawn protection to prevent bots from instantly killing you.
Weapons in the shop are now ordered by their unlock level.
Major revamps under the hood that should improve performance.
Improved performance for bullets, explosions, critical hits, and more!
Added a restriction to how often a player can enter a room.
Now players can no longer log into the game simultaneously with more than 1 account per IP.
Improved server stability.
Added a new panel where you can see the game rules and news without having to leave it. To access it, click the "?" button at the top right corner of the screen in the lobby.
This panel will open up automatically when a new update arrives.
Updated "Terms of Service" text on login screen to reflect the previous addition.
Added an alert when trying to use unauthorized characters in your nickname. This alert will also copy all allowed characters into your clipboard.
Camera shake can now be toggled in the settings.
Mouse sensitivity now can also be changed in the settings.

tags.balance_change: Slightly increased accuracy for Barrett, PG Mark I, and PG Mark II.

tags.bug: Fixed challenges being skippable after completing them.
Fixed Railgun and Void Reaper's projectiles spawning in the wrong position.
Fixed issues with spawning on the wrong sides in Elimination rooms.
Fixed issues with displaying incorrect frames/durations.
Fixed a bug where medals would not be properly shown on other profiles.
Fixed challenges being completed by room score rather than player score.
Fixed issues related to the active day streak popup.
Fixed an issue where the preferred music selection did not save properly.
Fixed customized keys not updating until rejoin.
Fixed word wrapping in lobby chat.
Several fixes to the sound engine.

notes.title: 09.05.2025 Update
notes.content:
Greetings players!

The team has released a new update which includes several fixes and improvements! Here's what changed:

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*]
[*] We updated level-up rewards! From now on, you'll be rewarded with more coins at higher levels! Here are the updated rewards:
[list]
[*] Levels 0-20: 500 coins
[*] Levels 21-40: 1,500 coins
[*] Levels 41+: 3,000 coins
[/list]
[*] Void Reaper can now be purchased!
[*] Increased clan logo size.
[list]
[*] Note: You may want to submit a new logo for your clan that is 200x200px.
[/list]
 [*] Added back Evilzone.
[*] Single Player mode is now available at level 1.
[*] Tournaments are now available at level 5.
[*] Single Player bots now spawn constantly as you kill them; they will also more actively get closer to you.
[*] Buying level packs now will only show options that can be purchased.
[*] Hidden weapon "Buy" button when skill requirement is not met.
[*] Combo and level-up text are now horizontally centered on the screen.
[*] Level-up text is now visible in the lobby when buying level packs.
[*] Hidden add/remove skill buttons if such skill is maxed out.
[*] Improved Settings menu translations.
[*] Improved Bank tab layout on Steam.
[/list]

[h2]QoL improvements[/h2]
[*] Tournament settings are now saved per game mode.
[*] You can now move the camera around while waiting to respawn in Elimination mode.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[*] Fixed softlocks and black screens in Single Player mode.
[*] Fixed a bug in Elimination mode regarding ending the match.
[*] Fixed a bunch of bullet collision issues in Nuclear Sand Storm and Evilzone.
[*] Fixed Thunderbringer projectile glow.
[*] Fixed ragdolls being toggled through gore instead of graphic settings.
[*] Fixed some nickname characters becoming a square.
[*] Fixed private messages tab not being updated properly when receiving new messages.
[*] Fixed mods not receiving private messages despite being online.
[*] Fixed a console error spam.

notes.title: 01.04.2025 Update
notes.content:
Greetings players!

We are already a fourth of the year in and to kick off this month, the team has prepared a new update with some unexpected effects for no particular reason at all...

[h2]New weapon![/h2]
[list]
[*] Introducing the [b]Void Reaper[/b], a h̶̾̒i̷͐͠g̶̑͝ḫ̴͝-level energy gun! It shoots a laser beam, just like the Railgun, that causes a small explosion when it touches a surface... or somebody!
[/list]

[h2]Promocode![/h2]
[list]
[*] To commemorate this update, we have also added a new promocode that gives a lot of coins and cash. Use [b]4Pr1lF00l5[/b] and see how much you get!
[/list]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Further tweaked crouch/crawl controls, now it should feel like it was before.
[*] Gore setting is now set to "low" by default. Blood is disabled when gore is set to low.
[*] Now you can create rooms for 2 and 3 players.
[list]
[*] Updated the default amount of players when creating a room from 8 to 4.
[/list]
[*] Players will get kicked due to inactivity when on spectator mode only if the game tab is not focused.
[*] Removed spam regarding undefined frames in the console.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue regarding managing weapons.
[/list]

As closing thoughts we'd like to share with all of you that we have plans to update the the EXP leveling system again. Since most players seem to be doing a lot of combos and progressing extremely fast despite our best efforts to keep the game balanced for everyone, we will be lowering everyone's levels to half along with reducing the EXP limit by 80%. Such changes will take place on 30.02.2026. Thanks for understanding, and thanks for playing!

[*] Fixed "manage weapons" screen not displaying weapons properly.
[*] Fixed an error when creating tournaments.
[*] Fixed some crashes.
[/list]

notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349766/b8beb4343d4b6127e58682df41d7b93fa2d0f991.png[/img]New update!
Greetings players!

Hope you had a great start of the year! We're kicking off 2025 with a brand new update for you to enjoy! 

New weapons
We are introducing FIVE NEW WEAPONS!

[list]
[*] MPF-45: A mid-level Sub-Machine Gun.
[*] Double Barrel: A high-level, "single-shot" Shotgun.
[*] Rubber Shotguns item won't work on this weapon.
[*] SIG-SPEAR: A high-level Assault Rifle.
[*] SKS-MK1: A low-level Sniper Rifle.
[*] Matchlock: A mid/high-level Medieval Weapon.
[/list]

These weapons will be given for free to our contest winners and randomly to beta subscribers. Later on, they will become available in the shop!

General
[list]
[*] Added a new player skin.
[*] Added language selection buttons on the Steam version.
[*] Removed EXP limit text if player is at max level.
[*] Improved anti-cheat.
[*] Reworked accuracy.
[*] Disabled Sniper Scope item from the shop if the player's accuracy skill points are 11 or more.
[*] Sniper Scope can no longer be obtained through daily rewards nor promo codes.
[*] This quite a big change since the accuracy calculations have changed considerably, so almost all weapons are affected by it. Let us know what you think by giving feedback in the ⁠support-and-feedback subforum!
[/list]

Balance changes
Along with the accuracy update, we have tweaked a bunch of weapons' stats to spice up the meta on all levels! The changes are the following:

🔴 MP7: Reduced damage from 620-640 to 580-600.
🟢 Gauss Rifle: Increased damage from 360-420 to 420-460.
🔵 WA2000: Updated damage from 510-550 to 500-560.
🟢 Gold Eagle: Increased max. damage from 90 to 120.
🔴 10mm SOP: Reduced min. damage from 210 to 190.
🟢 Calico M960: Increased max. damage from 55 to 65.
🟢 Jackhammer: Increased damage from 140-180 to 160-210.
🟢 AK-47: Increased damage from 130 to 125-145.
🟢 Steyer Aug: Increased damage from 150-190 to 170-210.
🟢 Assasin: Increased max. damage from 200 to 220.
🟢 OIXW XM8: Increased damage from 260-300 to 300-340.
🔵 FN-SCAR: Reduced ammo from 45 to 30. Increased shot delay from 0.15s to 0.2s. Increased damage from 160-170 to 200-240.
🔵 M29 Incisor: Increased shot delay from 0.16s to 0.18s. Increased damage from 240-270 to 250-290. Increased coins price from :coins: 4,850 to :coins: 6,790.
🟢 Dragunov: Increased damage from 560-600 to 650-700.
🟢 M60E4: Increased damage from 175-190 to 200-220.
🟢 RPD: Reduced shot delay from 0.17s to 0.16s.
🔴 Barrett: Reduced min. damage from 1,320 to 1,300. Changed bullet spread from 100 to 92.
🟢 VSS Vintorez: Reduced shot delay from 0.58s to 0.57s. Increased damage from 1,480- 1,550 to 1,530-1,580.
🔴 Gatling Gun: Reduced min. damage from 360 to 340.

EXP gathering and combos
In this update, we're also changing the way you gain EXP in the game. From now on, you can only get a certain amount of EXP per hour, which is a percentage that is split in half for both single player and multi player modes. These limits change depending on your level and reset every hour. The EXP limits are the following:

Levels 0-20: No limit
Levels 21-30 : 51%
Levels 31-40: 41%
Levels 41-50: 34%
Levels 51-60: 26%
Levels 61-70: 21%

Bug fixes
Fixed a bug when rejoining in Elimination rooms.
Fixed some issues in Corridor 2 and Canyon.
Fixed tournament rejoining being disabled if the stake was higher than your account balance after it started.
Fixed an error that allowed the camera to get way further than intended.
Fixed banned UI on Steam.

tags.feature:
New weapons
We are introducing FIVE NEW WEAPONS!
MPF-45: A mid-level Sub-Machine Gun.
Double Barrel: A high-level, "single-shot" Shotgun.
SIG-SPEAR: A high-level Assault Rifle.
SKS-MK1: A low-level Sniper Rifle.
Matchlock: A mid/high-level Medieval Weapon.
Added a new player skin.
Added language selection buttons on the Steam version.
Removed EXP limit text if player is at max level.
Improved anti-cheat.
Reworked accuracy.
Disabled Sniper Scope item from the shop if the player's accuracy skill points are 11 or more.
Sniper Scope can no longer be obtained through daily rewards nor promo codes.

tags.balance_change: 🔴 MP7: Reduced damage from 620-640 to 580-600.
🟢 Gauss Rifle: Increased damage from 360-420 to 420-460.
🔵 WA2000: Updated damage from 510-550 to 500-560.
🟢 Gold Eagle: Increased max. damage from 90 to 120.
🔴 10mm SOP: Reduced min. damage from 210 to 190.
🟢 Calico M960: Increased max. damage from 55 to 65.
🟢 Jackhammer: Increased damage from 140-180 to 160-210.
🟢 AK-47: Increased damage from 130 to 125-145.
🟢 Steyer Aug: Increased damage from 150-190 to 170-210.
🟢 Assasin: Increased max. damage from 200 to 220.
🟢 OIXW XM8: Increased damage from 260-300 to 300-340.
🔵 FN-SCAR: Reduced ammo from 45 to 30. Increased shot delay from 0.15s to 0.2s. Increased damage from 160-170 to 200-240.
🔵 M29 Incisor: Increased shot delay from 0.16s to 0.18s. Increased damage from 240-270 to 250-290. Increased coins price from :coins: 4,850 to :coins: 6,790.
🟢 Dragunov: Increased damage from 560-600 to 650-700.
🟢 M60E4: Increased damage from 175-190 to 200-220.
🟢 RPD: Reduced shot delay from 0.17s to 0.16s.
🔴 Barrett: Reduced min. damage from 1,320 to 1,300. Changed bullet spread from 100 to 92.
🟢 VSS Vintorez: Reduced shot delay from 0.58s to 0.57s. Increased damage from 1,480- 1,550 to 1,530-1,580.
🔴 Gatling Gun: Reduced min. damage from 360 to 340.
